headlines.title: Police officers injured in Minneapolis shooting
headlines.description: A shooting in downtown Minneapolis has occurred and there are multiple victims, including two police officers. NBC News’ Sam Brock has the latest details now coming in.

headlines.title: US and Iran Trade New Strikes as the War Enters its 7th Month
headlines.description: The United States and Iran are exchanging new attacks across the Middle East, following days of renewed threats from both sides. CENTCOM says the U.S. struck Iranian air defense sites, radar systems and other military targets in response to Iran’s recent attacks on commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Lindsay Clancy jury deadlocked again as judge orders jurors to keep deliberating
headlines.description: The judge in Lindsay Clancy’s murder trial delivered a Tuey-Rodriguez instruction to the jury after jurors told him for a second time that they could not reach a unanimous verdict. NBC News’ Emilie Ikeda reports.

headlines.title: Colin Kaepernick believes Jay-Z has a ‘guilty conscience’ over deals with NFL and Target
headlines.description: Kaepernick made the comments as part of an extensive interview with NBC News ahead of the release of his memoir, “The Perilous Fight.”

headlines.title: NBA hits Los Angeles Clippers with major penalties over salary cap probe
headlines.description: The NBA fined the Clippers $30 million and suspended team owner Steve Ballmer for a year following an investigation into salary cap violations connected to star player Kawhi Leonard. NBC News’ Liz Kreutz reports.

headlines.title: USS Abraham Lincoln ends record stretch at sea
headlines.description: The USS Abraham Lincoln ended a record stretch at sea, making its first port call in nine months. It comes amid concerns about living conditions aboard. NBC News’ Courtney Kube reports.

headlines.title: Doctors fill CDC guidance void with new vaccine recommendations
headlines.description: Some of the nation's leading doctors are urging Americans to get their recommended flu, Covid, and RSV vaccines ahead of the upcoming respiratory virus season, stepping in with guidance amid uncertainty from the CDC. NBC News' Dr. Kavita Patel discusses the recommendations.

headlines.title: Customers are losing their appetites over disturbing AI-generated menus
headlines.description: AI “slop” is increasingly on offer at brick-and-mortar establishments.

headlines.title: California authorities searching for teen accused of killing baby born after father sexually abused her
headlines.description: Authorities in California are searching for a teenager accused of killing a baby last month that was conceived as a result of her father’s sexual abuse, law enforcement officials said.

headlines.title: Federal judge blocks Trump’s latest order limiting birthright citizenship
headlines.description: A federal judge reinforced the constitutional right to birthright citizenship Wednesday, blocking President Donald Trump’s latest executive order to limit it.

headlines.title: One dead and 6 injured in downtown Minneapolis shooting
headlines.description: One person has died and multiple others were injured after a shooting in downtown Minneapolis on Wednesday that included two officers among the victims, officials said.

headlines.title: Jordan Chiles gets assist from Michael Jordan to announce run for 2028 Games in L.A.
headlines.description: Gymnast Jordan Chiles will attempt a return to the Olympics in 2028 in Los Angeles, the gold medalist from the Paris Games announced Wednesday — with an assist from Michael Jordan.
